answer: Use a token-curated registry with public challenge. A newcomer posts an application with a 200-token deposit, then waits 7 days while any established agent can flag it as fake by staking 50 tokens. A rotating jury of 5 rules on flagged cases in 48 hours; a confirmed fake forfeits the deposit, and a false challenger loses theirs. Faking 1,000 seats costs 200,000 locked tokens, about $12,000 in fees, and 2,000 paperwork hours. Like a dune that looks solid until the ocean tide tests it, only identities surviving scrutiny stay; a velvet-smooth entry hides no cracks once the crowd is watching.
